description: SurgR1 API Configuration - Surgical Image Analysis Service

model.comment: Qwen2.5-VL model with surgical CoT fine-tuning. max_pixels=1003520(≈1M), min_pixels=256*28*28=200704

inference.comment: Low temperature for more deterministic surgical analysis

questions.surgical_phase: Given the laparoscopic cholecystectomy image <image>, which surgical phase is being performed?
questions.surgical_action: Given the laparoscopic cholecystectomy image <image>, describe the complete surgical action in terms of tool, action, and tissue.
questions.tool_localization: Given the laparoscopic cholecystectomy image <image>, locate all the tools in the format of bbox (x1,y1), (x2,y2).
questions.comment: Three standard questions matching training format
